# KeyDir — Indian Mechanical Keyboard Community Directory

> Community-maintained, unbiased directory of mechanical keyboards, keycaps, switches, and related gear available in India. Covers verified vendors, DIY builders, brand stores, desk surfaces/mousepads, group buys, and a beginner setup guide. No ads, no affiliate links, no tracking.

## Directory

- [Vendors](https://keydir.in/vendors/): Verified Indian gear vendors selling keyboards, keycaps, switches, and accessories, filterable by category.
- [Builders](https://keydir.in/builders/): DIY builders — custom premium cable makers, structural modders, and custom-layout hardware artisans.
- [Brands](https://keydir.in/brands/): Official India manufacturer storefronts such as Ajazz, Cosmic Byte, TVS, and Xtro.
- [Surfaces](https://keydir.in/surfaces/): Tracking grid covering specialized mousepads, desk mats, and glasspads.
- [Group Buy](https://keydir.in/groupbuy/): Active, upcoming, and closed group buys tracked by the community.

## Resources

- [Setup Guide](https://keydir.in/guide/): Beginner-friendly guide on peripheral optimization, hardware modding, and maintenance.
- [About](https://keydir.in/about/): What KeyDir is and how the community maintains it.
- [Contact](https://keydir.in/contact/): Get in touch with the admins.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://keydir.in/terms-and-conditions/): Usage terms for the directory.

## App

- [KeyDir App](https://app.keydir.in/): Interactive catalog with live vendor prices, price history charts, spec comparison, and community voting.
